data.title: Sr. Manager of Security Architecture (Telemetry)-Peoria & Springfield, IL
data.description: Responsibilities Job Summary: As a Sr. Manager of Security Architecture & Engineering, you'll lead a team responsible for the platforms and processes that power security monitoring across Example Grocer's digital environment. This team owns security telemetry ingestion, log routing and transformation, SIEM administration, telemetry standards, and data onboarding. You'll ensure high-quality, reliable security data is available to support threat detection, incident response, and enterprise visibility while partnering with Engineering, Infrastructure, Cloud, and Security teams to continuously improve security monitoring capabilities. Qualifications & Key Requirements: Work Experience: 7+ years of experience leading Security Engineering, Security Operations, SIEM Engineering, or Security Platform teams responsible for enterprise-scale security monitoring and telemetry platforms. Experience administering and optimizing SIEM platforms, including Google SecOps, log ingestion pipelines, parser management, storage optimization, and integration health. Hands-on experience with Cribl or similar log routing and transformation technologies, including telemetry collection, normalization, enrichment, routing, and data pipeline reliability. Strong understanding of security telemetry architecture, including log onboarding, schema standards, data quality validation, and ensuring comprehensive visibility across cloud, SaaS, network, and application environments. data.title: Manager of Security Engineering-Edge (Peoria & Springfield, IL)
data.description: Responsibilities Job Summary: As a Manager, Edge Security Engineering, you'll lead a team responsible for securing Example Grocer's enterprise perimeter across network, cloud access, browser, endpoint, and email security. This team owns both the architecture and operation of security controls that ensure access is granted by policy, unauthorized access paths are eliminated, and data is protected across users, devices, workloads, and internal systems. The role is responsible for balancing operational excellence with automation and platform engineering, continuously improving security capabilities while driving efficiency at scale. Responsibilities include team leadership, strategic planning, prioritization, stakeholder management, budgeting, and performance management. Location: Springfield or Peoria, IL (Hybrid) Key Responsibilities & Essential Functions: Directs and controls the activities of a broad functional area through several departments within the function. Has control of planning, staffing, budget attainment, and recommending / implementing changes to methods.
